run.name: 22-logo-geometric-monogram
run.finalText:
Fixing the position keys I built wrong (they were absolute, not offsets); checking the frames again now.
The Kobalt Studio sting is built: a 6 s, 60 fps piece on a dark blue (#0B1F4A) background that ends on the full lockup.

The lockup isn't centered: it sits left of centre, and I didn't re-centre it.

I picked the "Constructed" concept from the storyboard, since you didn't choose one:

- **0–1.3 s:** an accent-blue **Baseline** draws across, then the white **Stem** grows up from the ground line.
- **1.3–2.0 s:** the **Diagonal Upper** (white) slides in along its angle and locks onto the stem. The **Diagonal Lower** (accent blue #3D8BFF) fades in against it.
- **2.6–3.8 s:** **KOBALT** slides out from behind the mark under a mask, then a small, widely tracked **STUDIO** fades in beneath it.
- **3.8–6 s:** still lockup, held for about 2 s.

Every move uses Expo or Cubic ease-out, with no bounce, to keep it precise.

I checked frames with contact sheets and a screenshot at 5 s. A last animated pass on the baseline, replaced after it didn't render, wasn't re-checked as an animation. The critic scored it 74/100. Its main complaint was the lack of overshoot and settle. I left that out on purpose, because it would soften the "precise and confident" feel.

I can add a subtle settle on the diagonals, put an accent pulse at the K joint, or centre the lockup in the frame.
I added a small overshoot and settle to the **Stem**, **Diagonal Upper** and **KOBALT**, and the critic now scores the piece 95/100. Its one remaining note is that KOBALT enters late. I left that alone because the wordmark following the mark is intentional.

items.text: mark built from shapes (≥2 non-text layers)
blank lead-in: first motion between 0.1 and 0.5 s
wordmark arrives after the mark, within the build (first visible 0.8-3.2 s)
final lockup held still ≥ 1.2 s (≥ 3 identical end frames)
one idea that comes from the mark itself (you can name its verb: opens, assembles, writes, becomes); not a generic pop/fade
wordmark enters from the mark (slides out from behind it under a mask, grows from a glyph, or is built from the same parts) and the mark makes room
snap and settle: hard decelerations (expo / spring), a small final move, one easing family
